messages:
Priya: Hi team — pinging for a quick review on a customer-specific patch for OrpheusHealth private deploy. Small routing + cert config change that fixes their 502s behind the VPC. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-configs/pull/2198
Sam: on it, thanks for the context. rough ETA 30–45m, unless it's huge.
Chen: can you paste the diff here? quick scan will help prioritize.
Priya: short snippet below — the change updates the ingress `host` and adds a TLS `secretName` override for the enterprise cert thumbprint:```yaml
# ingress override for orpheus-prod
host: orpheus.internal.redwood.example
annotations:
  ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "300"
tls:
  secretName: orpheus-enterprise-cert-2026-03
```
Jordan: :eyes: need to confirm the cert rotation process but minor, looks fine. please add a comment in the PR about manual rollback steps if the cert isn't available.
Sam: quick question — does this require a Dedicated routing change or is it purely customer-side k8s?
Priya: purely k8s values in the private deploy repo, no infra changes. I ran staging canaries — logs show the 502 gone after updating host and tls secret.
deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit, lint, helm-validate).
Chen: thanks, lgtm apart from one nit: drop the annotation key and move `proxy-read-timeout` into the `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout` namespace to match other customers. tiny YAML tweak.
Priya: good catch, updated the PR to reflect nginx annotation namespace. also added a short smoke test in PR description: `curl -H "Host: orpheus.internal.redwood.example" https://staging-orpheus.redwood.internal/health`
Sam: I can approve after the annotation change is squashed into a single commit. planning to merge during EOD merge window unless Jordan requests hold. :thumbsup:
Jordan: nope, go ahead once Sam approves. please add the rollback note (how to revert secretName and revert host) in the PR body per compliance.
Priya: added rollback steps and a note for on-call. thanks everyone — will watch the deploy and follow up if anything flaps.
Sam: approved and queued for merge in today's EOD window.
Priya: :raised_hands:
